page.notes: Arabic passages were read from the scan at reduced certainty; the Arabic after "regessit" and in the second quotation line may contain small errors. Two Arabic stretches are marked illegible where the letters could not be read with confidence. The bracketed "]" after "Motazalis" and the "[ præmii ]" insertion are as printed. The "AlMota-" at the foot is the catchword, cut off by the line end; the Arabic line beside it, "المعتزلة من القدرية", is part of the printed text. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
